AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MULTI-SPECIES MARINE
HATCHERY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ATIMONAN,
PROVINCE OF QUEZON AND APPROPRIATING
FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. There shall be established, under the
supervision of the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
of the Department of Agriculture (BFAR-DA), a multi-species
marine hatchery in the Municipality of Atimonan, Province
of Quezon.

Sc. 2. The BFAR-DA shall, within two (2) years after
the construction of the multi-species marine hatchery, transfer
the management of the same to the local government unit
concerned through a memorandum of agreement. Tt shall
implement a training and phasing-in program for local
government personnel on the management and operation of
the hatchery.

Sc. 3. The Secretary of Agriculture shall include in the
Department's programs the establishment of the:multi-species
marine hatchery in the Municipality of Atimonan, Province of
 
Quezon, the funding of which shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Act. The local government unit concerned
shall set aside funds from any available local revenue in an
amount deemed appropriate for the operationalization of the
hatchery.

SEC. 4. Within sixty (60) days from the passage of
this Act, the Secretary of Agriculture shall issue the rules and.
regulations on the supervision, monitoring, ,transfer, or
withdrawal by the BFAR of the multi-species marine hatchery.

SEc. 5. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after
its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of
generai circulation.
